known_limitation: Projection-measured corridor width (median 1.91 m, IQR [1.59, 2.45]) is ~22% narrower than the trajectory-derived 2.45 m spacing. This symmetric narrowing does NOT bias the primary two-row centreline metric (midpoint is preserved); it affects only width-dependent measures (D-G single-row fallback prior). Likely cause: bbox-bottom projects to the visible inner edge of trunk/pole rather than true ground contact, plus possible sub-cm pitch/height offset from Table 3 nominal. Refinement (true-ground-contact detection) is future work.
